$comment: Minimum pass rate per subset (AGT-14). A change that lowers any value is blocked in review (ADR-022). Subsets with no cases are reported and skipped; the case counts grow per feature (plan §3). The extraction-* values are the extraction subset's precision, recall and extracted-price accuracy (FEAT-012 AC-6), not pass rates. `coaching` is the coaching subset's pass rate (FEAT-027 AC-14).
